about: Renderer data for RLHeadPortraitMap: how a Human's saved appearance (PortraitCustomization PC/1-PC/2 fields and palette indices) becomes the RL head at High. Changing it changes every Human at High equally (players, NPCs, legacy saves); it is never sent on the wire.

controls.about: x = clamp(gain * (v - c) / 50, -cap, cap), c = the field's value in HumanPortraitPresets Rowan (male) / Mira (female). Gains per body sex from tests/rl_head_gain_probe.gd (2026-10-27): |gain| matches the RL control's displacement per slider unit to the Low/Medium sculpt's near the centre (95th-percentile magnitudes, mean of both directions); eye_size and its eyelid coupling by joint least squares. eye_tilt is negative: RL eye_tilt + raises the inner corners, the Low/Medium slider the outer ones. Secondary couplings are the plan's (jaw, nose, face_length, brow_depth) and the probe's (eye_size -> eyelid).

hair.about: An RL module's hl_length/hl_volume weights: clamp(shapeGain * (v - preset) / 50, -1, 1), preset = Rowan's values for rowan_shag, Mira's for mira_bun.

detail.about: An RL module's fine-detail level (0-100; 50 = authored, lower drops flyaway and wisp cards, 0 smooth, above 50 fades in the messy extras - keep levels 0.05-0.45 - and adds strand contrast) from the hair finish's slider position s (0 sleekest .. 100 messiest; the saved finishes sit at Swept 25, Classic 50, Tousled 75): piecewise linear through (0, 0), (sliderPresetFinish, 50) and (100, 100), rounded, sliderPresetFinish = the slider position of the module's own preset finish (Rowan Tousled for rowan_shag, Mira Swept for mira_bun), so each preset finish is the authored look. Owner decision (colour model spec revision 3, 4.7). Gives rowan_shag Swept 17 / Classic 33 / Tousled 50 and mira_bun Swept 50 / Classic 67 / Tousled 83.

colours.about: sRGB per palette index (skin 0-9, hair colour 0-19, eyes 0-11; beards by hair colour, male only) per body sex, so the lit RL head matches what Low/Medium show for the same index: tests/integration/rl_head_colour_calibration.gd (Forward+, neutral stage light, 3 linear-light iterations): skin and eyes 2026-10-27, hair and beards 2026-10-28 for the flat painterly hair shading (rl_hair.gdshader: the diffuse no longer squares the colour; beards drawn at beard_gain). Residuals (max sRGB channel): skin 0.0002, eyes 0.0001, hair 0.001, beards 0.0005 - every hair and beard colour lands on the Low/Medium look (before the shading change: hair 0.09, the darkest colours too light; beards 0.27, light beards capped near 0.46 sRGB). Brows are the hair colour x browFromHair.

defaults.about: Seed values for owner review (PC/3 spec 2.5). Arrays are indexed by skin index (freckles, liner, lip_tint wire value 1-12 into lipTints) or by facial_hair (stubble).
